objective: The multi-agent workflow (package 18.8): the fraud, churn and delivery replicas run end to end by dclab_core's roles together on the workflow graph (analyst and checker, investigator, planner, engineer, critic, reporter), with a scripted person who answers what is asked and signs the gates; judged by team_gate_v1, fixed before the first run.
rule: Scores are evidence about these roles on these replicas, not about any model's readiness for production. Every run is capped in euros and recorded here.
known_limits: Three invented replicas, one model, one run each.
The person is scripted: a real person may answer differently or not at all.
